commit: 1afd3a1 (last server change; main was at db17d5a)
target: https://shortened.cv/{slug}, one active link, 302 to https://example.com/?ref=smoke
path: k6 -> public IP -> Traefik (TLS, Let's Encrypt) -> Go API -> in-process cache; every click recorded through the Redis stream into PostgreSQL

host.provider: Contabo VPS shared with two other applications, managed by Coolify
host.cpu: AMD EPYC Processor (with IBPB), 4 vCPU, KVM

load_generator.location: same VPS, so it shared the 4 vCPUs with the services under test
load_generator.connections: keep-alive; each virtual user reuses its TLS connection
load_generator.user_agent: desktop Chrome string, so requests are recorded as human clicks

api.app_env: development (production mode was not yet enabled; it changes cookie flags, not the redirect path)

runs.run1-50-to-1000: 60 s per step at a constant arrival rate, no warm-up. Stops when errors exceed 1% or p95 exceeds 500 ms.
runs.run2-1000-to-3000: 20 s ramp to the target rate, then 60 s held. Only the held window is measured (hold_* metrics) and checked against the same limits.

measurement.cpu: vmstat and top sampled every 5 s; process CPU is a percentage of one vCPU
